CFML Language Reference: Functions

FindOneOf

Returns the position of the first character in a string that also appears in a set of characters. The search is case-sensitive.

Category

String functions

Syntax

FindOneOf(set, string [, start ])

Parameters

set
A string of characters to look for. Each character is searched for on its own.
string
The string to search.
start
Optional. Position at which to start searching. Default 1.

Returns

The position of the first character found, or 0 if none of the characters occur.

Usage

Useful for checking input for forbidden characters, for example FindOneOf("<>""", Form.Name). To search for a whole substring use Find; for patterns use REFind.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Words = "rhythm,KoldFusion,crypt,spoon">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Word</TH><TH>First vowel at</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Words#" INDEX="w">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#w#</TD><TD ALIGN="CENTER">#FindOneOf("aeiouAEIOU", w)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
